item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 10/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting the coast of southern China will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will improve and temperatures will rise slightly over the region. A cold front will reach the coast of Guangdong on Sunday. Temperatures will fall again and there will be a few rain patches over the region. The monsoon associated with the cold front is expected to be replaced by an easterly airstream midweek next week.
